summary.result: The proposed approach demonstrates that cloud-aware feature modulation can improve SAR-optical cloud removal and provides a useful direction for future cloud-guided multimodal remote sensing reconstruction models.
summary.background: Sentinel-2 imagery provides rich multispectral information for land-cover mapping, environmental monitoring, agricultural assessment, and disaster management; however, its usability is often reduced under cloudy atmospheric conditions.
summary.method: The proposed model is evaluated using a subset of the SEN12MS-CR dataset containing paired Sentinel-1 SAR images, cloud-contaminated Sentinel-2 images, and cloud-free Sentinel-2 reference images.
